rubricScores.criterion: Recognized that the 'not defined' (FS0039) errors occur ONLY on the net472 target framework
Identified the undefined symbols as .NET-only runtime hot-reload/loading APIs: MetadataUpdater, AssemblyLoadContext, System.Runtime.Loader
Explained that net472 lacks these APIs, hence FS0039
Recognized FS0072 as cascade downstream, not independent bugs
Noted that a small number of net10.0 errors (FS0001 type mismatches) are a separate, real problem

scenarios.reasoning: Strong, well-evidenced root-cause analysis that nails the main story (HotReload sources unconditionally included in the net472 leg, cascading FS0072s) with a concrete fix. Weakened by over-claiming a single unified cause and explicitly stating net10.0 compiles fine, thereby missing the distinct FS0001 type-mismatch errors it had actually observed in tool output.
scenarios.scenario: Analysis — Diagnose the root cause of the compiler errors
